About Us

Every piece begins as an idea. We manufacture it into a legacy.

For over sixteen years, Diamonds and More has combined master craftsmanship, innovative design, and precision manufacturing to create jewellery that reflects luxury, elegance, and enduring value. We transform ideas into market-ready collections — from timeless classics to contemporary masterpieces — helping our retail partners strengthen their brand identity and delight their clientele.

Commitment to Quality

Every piece earns its polish

Every piece manufactured by Diamonds and More undergoes rigorous quality control — because a retailer's reputation depends on what leaves our workshop. Everything is manufactured in-house, from design to final polish, with no outsourcing to third-party goldsmiths.

  • In-house manufacturing — everything made under one roof
  • 18K, 14K & 9K hallmarked, IGI-certified jewellery
  • Exceptional diamond setting precision
  • Superior finishing & polish
  • Timely delivery & long-term reliability
